skills.name: my-skills
skills.description: Sync and manage Claude Code skills across multiple machines using GitHub. Use this skill whenever the user says /my-skills, wants to sync skills between devices, back up their skills to GitHub, install skills from a remote repo, manage skill synchronization, or asks about sharing skills across machines. Trigger on phrases like 'sync my skills', 'push skills', 'pull skills', 'set up skill sync', 'list my remote skills'.
headings: my-skills — Claude Code Skill Sync Manager
